examples.trans: Kostya, just do not blurt out anything extra up there!

examples.text: Ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: There's nothing left.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('extra').

examples.text: Костя, только ничего лишнего там не сболтни!
examples.trans: Kostya, just do not blurt out anything extra up there!

examples.text: Вчера я наговорила вам лишнего.
examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.

examples.text: У вас есть лишний билет?
examples.trans: Do you have a spare ticket?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сеня, там свежее мясо привезли.
examples.trans: Senya, they delivered fresh meat over there.

examples.text: Костя, только ничего лишнего там не сболтни!
examples.trans: Kostya, just do not blurt out anything extra up there!

examples.text: Там всё нормально.
examples.trans: Everything's fine there.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'болтнуть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'blurt out'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и сболтнуть вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and blurt out on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют сболтнуть.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to blurt out.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'вериться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'trust'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и довериться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and trust on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют довериться.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to trust.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'but, after all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я сделал ей нормальное предложение.
examples.trans: I made her a proper marriage proposal.

examples.text: Это ты у жены под каблуком!
examples.trans: You are the one under your wife's thumb!

examples.text: Ты уже должен быть дома, Сеня!
examples.trans: You should already be home, Senya!
